'''FC Nõmme United''' is an [[Estonia]]n professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Nõmme]], a district in [[Tallinn]]. The club was founded in 2000 and competes in the [[Meistriliiga]], the top flight of [[Estonian football league system|Estonian football]], following promotion from the [[2025 Esiliiga]] as league champions.  The club's home ground is [[Männiku Stadium]].

Led by [[Mart Poom]], Nõmme United is renowned for its strong youth system.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 November 2023 |title=Premium liigasse saanud Nõmme United jääb põhimõtetele kindlaks. Poom: kasvatajaklubi nimi mind ei häiri |trans-title=Nõmme United, who has entered the Premium Liiga, remains true to its principles. Poom: I don't mind the feeder club image |url=https://sport.delfi.ee/artikkel/120242096/premium-liigasse-saanud-nomme-united-jaab-pohimotetele-kindlaks-poom-kasvatajaklubi-nimi-mind-ei-hairi |access-date= |website=Delfi Sport |language=}}</ref> The club debuted in Meistriliiga in 2024 and will compete in the top flight again from 2026."}}
